words.definition_en: the human race; human beings collectively.
words.sentence_en: Prometheus felt deep sympathy for humankind and decided to help them.
words.sentence_tw: 普羅米修斯對人類感到深深的同情，決定幫助他們。
words.analysis: 與 humanity 階為不可數名詞，指全體人類。常用於探討人類歷史、文明或與大自然相對立的語境。
words.timing: 撰寫作文論述人類文明發展、大自然保護或科技對人類的影響時使用。

words.definition_en: all existing matter and space considered as a whole; the cosmos.
words.sentence_en: Earth is just a small planet in the universe.
words.sentence_tw: 地球只是宇宙中的一顆小行星。
words.analysis: 指整個宇宙，通常前面會加定冠詞 the。衍生形容詞 universal 表示「普遍的、萬能的」。
words.timing: 討論天文、科學，或是描述某種道理/規律是「放諸四海皆準」時。

words.definition_en: the short, fine, soft hair of certain animals.
words.sentence_en: Animals with thick fur can survive in freezing cold winters.
words.sentence_tw: 擁有厚實毛皮的動物能在嚴寒的冬天生存。
words.analysis: 不可數名詞，指軟毛皮。若要表達環保或人造材質，常搭配 fake fur 或 artificial fur。
words.timing: 描述動物特徵、冬天禦寒衣物或動物權益議題時。

words.definition_en: to give (someone) the authority or means to do something; make it possible for.
patterns: enable sb. to + V（使某人能夠做某事）
words.sentence_en: The internet enables people to communicate instantly around the world.
words.sentence_tw: 網際網路使人們能夠與全世界即時溝通。
words.analysis: 核心用法為 enable + 受詞 + to V，強調「提供條件、能力或資源」讓某人可以完成某事。
words.timing: 說明某種工具、技術、環境或行為帶來的正面賦能或便利時。

words.definition_en: in or into a vertical position; sitting or standing straight up.
words.sentence_en: Prometheus gave humans the ability to stand upright.
words.sentence_tw: 普羅米修斯給予了人類直立站立的能力。
words.analysis: 可作形容詞或副詞。常用於描述人的坐姿、站姿或物體的垂直放置方式。
words.timing: 描述姿勢、體態，或比喻為人正直（upright citizen）時。

words.definition_en: showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary.
patterns: It is generous of sb. to + V（某人做某事真慷慨）
related_words: generosity (n. [U]) 慷慨（show generosity to sb.）
words.sentence_en: It was very generous of him to share his resources with others.
words.sentence_tw: 他與他人分享資源真是太慷慨了。
words.analysis: 描述人的特質為大方、不吝嗇。形容人格特質時，句型常用 It is generous of sb. to V。
words.timing: 稱讚他人大方付出、捐款或協助時使用。

words.definition_en: a serious disagreement or argument; to be incompatible.
collocations: come into conflict with（與……發生衝突）
words.sentence_en: His personal goals came into conflict with his company's policies.
words.sentence_tw: 他的個人目標與公司的政策產生了衝突。
words.analysis: 作名詞重音在第一音節 [ˈkɑnflɪkt]，作動詞重音在第二音節 [kənˈflɪkt]。 conflict with 表意見、時間或利益抵觸。
words.timing: 討論爭執、人際問題、時間衝突或利益衝突時。

words.definition_en: the action of sharing something out among a number of recipients.
related_words: distribute (vt.) 分發；分配（be distributed to...）
words.sentence_en: The distribution of resources among the regions was unfair.
words.sentence_tw: 資源在各區域之間的分配是不公平的。
words.analysis: 動詞為 distribute。可指物品/食物的分發，也可指人口、物種在地理上的地理分布。
words.timing: 探討資源配置、物流、社會公平或數據分布時。

words.definition_en: an advantage or profit gained from something; receive an advantage.
collocations: be of great benefit to sb.（對某人很有幫助）
words.sentence_en: Regular exercise will be of great benefit to your health.
words.sentence_tw: 定期運動對你的健康非常有益。
words.analysis: 作動詞時，S benefit from... 表「主詞從……獲益」；A benefit B 表「A 對 B 有好處」。
words.timing: 作文撰寫優缺點分析（pros and cons）或說明政策/習慣好處時。

words.definition_en: to kill (animals) for food, or kill (people) in large numbers violently.
words.sentence_en: The cattle were raised and sent to the farm to be slaughtered.
words.sentence_tw: 這些家畜被飼養並送到農場宰殺。
words.analysis: 既可指商業上的屠宰家畜，也可指戰爭或殘暴事件中的大規模屠殺。
words.timing: 討論畜牧、動物權益或歷史戰爭事件時。

words.definition_en: directly under or beneath something.
words.sentence_en: She found her missing keys underneath the couch.
words.sentence_tw: 她在沙發底下找到了遺失的鑰匙。
words.analysis: 介系詞，比 under 更強烈地表達「被蓋住、在緊貼下方」的概念，有時用於比喻「在表面之下/內心深處」。
words.timing: 描述空間位置或探討人隱藏的真實內心時。

words.definition_en: turn into ice or another solid as a result of extreme cold.
words.sentence_en: Without fire, early humans would freeze to death in winter.
words.sentence_tw: 沒有火，早期的人類在冬天會凍死。
words.analysis: 三態為 freeze-froze-frozen。 freeze to death 指凍死。也可指電腦畫面凍結、或驚嚇時僵住（freeze up）。
words.timing: 描述極端天氣、寒冷環境或生動表情姿態時。

words.definition_en: a person harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event.
collocations: fall victim to...（成為……的受害者）
words.sentence_en: Humans often fell victim to wild beasts before they had fire and weapons.
words.sentence_tw: 在擁有火和武器之前，人類經常成為野獸的受害者。
words.analysis: fall victim to 是極常見的高中片語，後面接犯罪、疾病、災難或詐騙事件。
words.timing: 討論社會新聞、天然災害、詐騙或疾病防範時。

words.definition_en: wretchedly unhappy or uncomfortable.
words.sentence_en: Living in extreme cold without basic food made their lives miserable.
words.sentence_tw: 生活在極寒之中且缺乏基本食物使他們的生活非常悲慘。
words.analysis: 形容極度痛苦、淒慘的生活或心情，感情色彩遠比 sad 強烈。
words.timing: 描寫災民生活困境、不幸遭遇或極糟糕的天氣/心情時。

words.definition_en: having a hole or empty space inside.
words.sentence_en: Prometheus hid the stolen fire inside a hollow stalk.
words.sentence_tw: 普羅米修斯將偷來的火種藏在一根中空的植物莖幹中。
words.analysis: 實體指「內部空的」（如樹幹、竹子）；比喻指「虛偽的、空洞的」（hollow victory 虛假的勝利，hollow promise 空頭支票）。
words.timing: 描述物理結構（竹子/管狀物）或比喻言行缺乏誠意時。

words.definition_en: extremely angry.
collocations: be furious at/about sth.（對某事感到暴怒）
be furious with sb.（對某人感到暴怒）
words.sentence_en: Zeus was furious about Prometheus's theft of fire.
words.sentence_tw: 宙斯對普羅米修斯盜取火種一事感到非常暴怒。
words.analysis: 程度遠高於 angry。情緒極度高漲憤怒。對事情用 at/about，對人用 with。
words.timing: 作文中用來替代 angry，加強語氣表達極度震怒的情緒。

words.definition_en: the action or crime of stealing.
words.sentence_en: The theft of intellectual property is a serious legal issue.
words.sentence_tw: 智慧財產權的偷竊行為是嚴重的法律問題。
words.analysis: theft 是名詞「偷竊行為/罪名」，而 thief 是指執行偷竊的人（小偷）。
words.timing: 討論法律、網路犯罪或社會治安相關議題時。

words.definition_en: inflict a penalty or sanction on (someone) for a fault or crime.
words.sentence_en: Zeus decided to punish Prometheus by chaining him to a mountain.
words.sentence_tw: 宙斯決定懲罰普羅米修斯，將他鎖在山崖上。
words.analysis: 常用於 punish sb. for sth.（因某事懲罰某人）。
words.timing: 討論教育、法律處分或神話道德報應時。

words.definition_en: send (someone) away from a country or place as an official punishment.
words.sentence_en: The traitor was banished from the kingdom forever.
words.sentence_tw: 這個叛徒被永遠放逐出該王國。
words.analysis: 強烈語氣的驅逐，常伴隨政治、歷史或神話色彩。也可比喻消除疑慮（banish fear）。
words.timing: 描寫歷史故事、神話奇幻文學或驅逐負面情緒時。

words.definition_en: the action or practice of inflicting severe pain on someone.
words.sentence_en: Enduring the relentless heat every day was pure torture for him.
words.sentence_tw: 每天忍受酷熱對他來說純粹是折磨。
words.analysis: 既指肉體上的酷刑拷問，也指心理上的煎熬或痛苦折磨。
words.timing: 描述嚴酷的身體/精神煎熬，或批判非人道行為時。

words.definition_en: the stage of human social and cultural development and organization that is considered most advanced.
words.sentence_en: The discovery of fire set the stage for human civilization.
words.sentence_tw: 火的發現為人類文明奠定了基礎。
words.analysis: 指社會發展到高級階段的文明體系。動詞為 civilize（使文明/教化）。
words.timing: 歷史、社會學或探討科技對人類文明演進時。

phrases.sentence_en: By the time he got to human beings, he had run out of gifts.
phrases.sentence_tw: 當他來到人類面前時，他的禮物已經用光了。
phrases.analysis: 人 run out of物（某人用光某物）；物 run out（某物用完了）。

phrases.sentence_en: To make up for their weaker state, Prometheus gave them fire.
phrases.sentence_tw: 為了彌補人類較為弱小的狀態，普羅米修斯給了他們火。
phrases.analysis: 同義詞為 compensate for。常用於彌補缺失、損失或時間。

phrases.sentence_en: As a result, from that day on, humans would keep the meat for themselves.
phrases.sentence_tw: 因此，從那天起，人類就把肉留給自己。
phrases.analysis: 轉承詞，放在句首引導結果。同義詞為 therefore, consequently。

phrases.definition_tw: 成為……的受害者；受到……的傷害
phrases.sentence_en: Humans often fell victim to wild beasts.
phrases.sentence_tw: 人類過去經常成為野獸的受害對象。
phrases.analysis: 常接野獸、疾病、詐騙或天然災害。

phrases.sentence_en: An eagle fed on Prometheus's liver every day.
phrases.sentence_tw: 一隻老鷹每天以普羅米修斯的肝臟為食。
phrases.analysis: 主詞通常為動物或昆蟲，表示以某種食物為主食。

phrases.definition_tw: 為……奠定基礎 / 做好準備
phrases.sentence_en: The gift of fire set the stage for human civilization.
phrases.sentence_tw: 火的禮物為人類文明奠定了基礎。
phrases.analysis: 比喻為未來的事件、發展或變革鋪路或準備好舞台。

patterns.title: 句型 1：Not only ... but also ...（不僅……而且……）
patterns.structure: Not only A but also B ...
patterns.explanation: 對等連接詞片語，用來連接兩個詞性、結構相同的單字、片語或子句。當連接兩個名詞作為句子的主詞時，動詞的單複數須與鄰近的後者主詞一致 (B)。語意上通常更強調 but also 後面帶出的新訊息。
patterns.sentence_en: Prometheus gave humans not only the ability to stand upright but also the gift of fire.
patterns.sentence_tw: 普羅米修斯不僅給予人類直立站立的能力，還給予了火的禮物。

practice.original: Jessie is an outstanding artist. She is also a promising athlete.
practice.combined: Jessie is not only an outstanding artist but also a promising athlete.

practice.original: Jessica was impressed with the magic show. Her friends were also impressed with the magic show.
practice.combined: Not only Jessica but also her friends were impressed with the magic show.

patterns.title: 句型 2：By the time 與完成時態的搭配
patterns.explanation:
By the time 表示「在……之前 / 到……的時候」。常用於強調某一動作在另一個時間點或動作發生前就已經完成：
1. 過去時間軸：By the time + S + 過去式 (V-ed), S + had + p.p. (過去完成式)
2. 未來時間軸：By the time + S + 現在式 (代替未來), S + will have + p.p. (未來完成式)
patterns.sentence_en: By the time he got to human beings, he had run out of gifts.
patterns.sentence_tw: 在他的來到人類面前時，他的禮物已經用光了。
examples: By the time the police arrived at the scene, the bank robbers had run away.
By the time you read this letter, I will have boarded a plane to Sydney.
By the time Sasha goes to college, her parents will have turned 65.
